name: Christians Who Continue To Sin
overview: Scripture teaches that Christians who continue to sin face serious spiritual consequences, especially when sin is willful and done with full knowledge of the truth, as Hebrews 10:26 warns there remains no further sacrifice for such sins. James 4:17 emphasizes that knowingly failing to do good is itself sin, highlighting the responsibility believers have to live obediently. At the same time, Matthew 7:1 reminds Christians to avoid judgment toward others, underscoring the need for humility in addressing sin within the body of Christ.
